Meet Peri

Peri is pro-aging, solution-focused self-care. She’s hot. She feels good and looks good doing it. She’s clean. She’s clinically researched. And she’s backed by science.

Peri gets women's health. She knows this isn’t about fighting age, it’s about embracing change and feeling empowered through it. She knows you want calm, clarity, and control. That your hormones haven’t exactly been playing nice. Peri was made for you. To support your mood. To bring balance back. To help you feel more like you.

Recommended Usage

Daily: One sachet every day is recommended.

Consistency Matters: Minimum 4-6 weeks and continue with daily use to experience optimal benefits from PERICALM

• 8,000 mg of VERISOL® Collagen

Contains VERISOL® bioactive collagen peptides, which have been clinically studied to support skin health and maintain skin elasticity.

• Adaptogenic Maca Root

Traditionally used in South American medicine to support vitality and help the body adapt to stress, including during times of hormonal change.

• White Grape Seed Extract

A source of antioxidants that helps reduce free radical damage and supports general health and wellbeing. Has been studied for its potential to support skin and cardiovascular health during menopause.

• Cultavit® Activated B-Complex

Provides activated B vitamins that support energy production, assist with healthy stress response, and contribute to normal cognitive and skin function.

• Magnesium Lactate

Supports nervous system function and muscle health. May help reduce muscle cramps and support healthy sleep patterns.

• Vitamin C

Supports collagen formation, contributes to healthy immune system function, and helps reduce free radical damage to body cells.

• Vitamin D3

Supports bone health, immune system function, and assists in the regulation of calcium metabolism. May help maintain healthy mood balance.

• EpiBright™

A botanical complex containing plant-based antioxidants. Antioxidants help reduce free radicals formed in the body and support skin health.

settings.title: VERISOL® F COLLAGEN PEPTIDES (8000 mg)
settings.description: During perimenopause, declining estrogen levels can affect skin integrity. VERISOL® has been clinically studied for its ability to support collagen production and maintain skin elasticity as part of healthy aging.

settings.title: ADAPTOGENIC MACA ROOT (200mg)
settings.description: A clinically supported adaptogen that targets the HPA axis, not by replacing hormones, but by helping your body balance and respond to fluctuating estrogen and progesterone. Maca root has been clinically studied for its potential to support hot flush frequency, sexual function, mood, and emotional wellbeing in women during menopause.

settings.title: WHITE GRAPE SEED EXTRACT
settings.description: White Grape Seed Extract has been clinically studied for its potential to support skin health, collagen maintenance, cardiovascular function, and temperature regulation during menopause.

settings.title: CULTAVIT® ACTIVATED B-COMPLEX (170mg)
settings.description: Cultavit® Activated B-Complex provides bioavailable forms of B1, B2, B3, B5, B6, B7, B9, and B12, which support energy production, nervous system function, cognitive performance, and healthy skin. B vitamins also play a role in nutrient metabolism and cellular repair, key functions that may be especially important during perimenopause.

settings.title: MAGNESIUM LACTATE (1000 mg)
settings.description: Magnesium is an essential mineral involved in over 300 enzymatic processes in the body, including those related to energy production, nervous system function, and muscle health. During times of hormonal fluctuation, such as perimenopause, magnesium may help support mood balance, sleep quality, and stress resilience.

settings.title: XOBIOME® EPIBRIGHT POSTBIOTIC (100 mg)
settings.description: A precision-formulated postbiotic complex designed to support gut and skin health. Postbiotics are produced through fermentation and may help maintain healthy immune function, support the skin barrier, and contribute to overall digestive balance—factors linked to skin appearance and resilience.

settings.title: ACEROLA JUICE POWDER (200 mg)
settings.description: A potent, natural source of vitamin C containing significantly more than oranges, Acerola helps support collagen production and defend skin cells against oxidative stress. Its antioxidant properties play a vital role in maintaining skin resilience and radiance, especially during times of increased physical or environmental stress.

settings.title: VITAMIN D3 (2 mg / 80 IU)
settings.description: A vital nutrient that supports bone health, immune system function, and mood regulation. Vitamin D deficiency is common in women over 35 and may be associated with reduced bone density and changes in mood and immune resilience during midlife.

settings.title: What is PeriCalm?
settings.text: PeriCalm is a scientifically formulated supplement designed to support women during the perimenopausal phase of life. It combines evidence-based nutrients and botanicals traditionally used in Western herbal medicine to support emotional wellbeing, energy production, and general health as the body transitions through hormonal changes.

settings.title: Who can take PeriCalm?
settings.text: PeriCalm is intended for adult women experiencing the natural transition leading up to menopause. If you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or have a medical condition, please consult your healthcare practitioner before use.

settings.title: How should I take PeriCalm?
settings.text: Adults: take the recommended dose as shown on the product label, with water or food. Always follow the directions for use, and do not exceed the recommended dosage unless advised by your healthcare professional.

settings.title: How long should I take PeriCalm for?
settings.text: You can take PeriCalm daily as part of your ongoing wellness routine. For best results, consistent use over several weeks is recommended, as natural ingredients may take time to build in the body. If symptoms persist, talk to your healthcare professional.

settings.title: What benefits does PeriCalm provide?
settings.text:
PeriCalm has been formulated with ingredients that:

  • Support emotional balance and healthy mood

  • Help maintain energy levels and vitality

  • Support the body’s stress response

  • Support general wellbeing and hormonal health during perimenopause These are general health support claims consistent with listed-medicine guidelines.

settings.title: Can I take PeriCalm alongside other supplements or medications?
settings.text: If you are currently taking prescription medication, hormone therapy, or other supplements, please check with your healthcare practitioner before using PeriCalm to ensure there are no interactions.

settings.title: Is PeriCalm suitable for vegans and vegetarians?
settings.text: Please refer to the ingredients panel for details. PeriCalm does not contain artificial colours, flavours, or preservatives, and is free from common allergens where possible.

settings.title: How is PeriCalm made?
settings.text: PeriCalm is proudly formulated in Australia using premium ingredients that meet Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) standards. Each batch is tested to ensure purity, consistency, and compliance with Australian quality regulations.

settings.title: What should I do if I experience any unwanted effects?
settings.text: Discontinue use and consult your healthcare professional if you experience any adverse reactions. Always read the label and follow the directions for use. Supplements should not replace a balanced diet.
PERICALM INGREDIENTS
